name: 加那利群岛的一般间接税 (3SS)
name_en: General Indirect Tax in the Canary Islands (3SS)
description_en_html:
Overview

The process starts with the creation of a customer and standard sales order. Depending on the customer, the process starts with the creation of a customer standard sales order. After picking is completed, the shipping specialist relieves the inventory. This inventory relief is the actual recording of the physical quantity that is being shipped to the customer.

With the goods issue posting, revenue is recognized, and the cost of goods sold is recorded in Financial Accounting.

Once goods are delivered, you can invoice the delivery.

The IGIC (Impuesto General Indirecto Canario) tax only applies to goods and services delivered in the Canary Islands territory. IGIC replaces VAT calculation and reporting to tax authorities for all Inland and Canary companies delivering from plants located in Canary Islands to Canary customers. Inland companies delivering from Inland plants to Canary customers will apply VAT for export.

Key Process Flow

  • Create a sales order
  • Print order confirmation
  • Create delivery
  • Execute picking
  • Post goods issue
  • Create billing document

Business Benefits

  • Capture the destination country via the End User for Foreign Trade partner trade (for occasions when you ship to the border or customer’s customs broker)
description_zh_html:
概览

该流程从创建客户和标准销售订单开始。根据客户，该流程从创建客户标准销售订单开始。拣配完成后，装运专员将释放库存。此库存减免 是实际记录装运到客户的实际数量。

通过发货过账，确认收入，并在财务会计中记录销货成本。

交货后，您可以为交货开发票。

IGIC (Impuesto General Indiroto Canario) 税仅适用于在加那利群岛地域内交付的商品和服务。对于从位于加那利群岛的工厂交付给加那利客户的所有内陆和加那利公司，IGIC 取代了增值税计算和向税务部门报告。从内陆工厂交货到加那利客户的内陆公司将申请出口增值税。

关键流程流

  • 创建销售订单
  • 打印订单确认
  • 创建交货
  • 执行拣配
  • 过账发货
  • 创建开票凭证

业务优势

  • 通过外贸最终用户合作伙伴贸易捕获目的地国家/地区（适用于装运到边境或客户的报关代理的情况）
